description:
Create a full-access catalog/inventory API key. Requires OAuth security:write.

    The secret is returned ONCE. Store it securely; never include it in a public
    message or logs. This grants broader catalog/inventory access than a limited
    OAuth token. It cannot manage account settings or credentials through MCP.
    Each call creates a new key; do not retry blindly after a lost response.
name: create_account_api_key
